title: microcoelia dolichorhiza
intro: Microcoelia dolichorhiza, commonly known as the "orchid parasite," is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is known to have various health benefits, including its use in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. Microcoelia dolichorhiza contains bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit antimicrobial properties, which may be useful in the prevention of infections.
